title: The photo reel · Devcon 8 Music Sanctuary
lede: Thirty-some frames of the room the Open Source Orchestra was born in: the Music Sanctuary at Devcon 8, Mumbai, 3–6 November 2026. Official Devcon photographs, already public in the Mandala Room; nobody is named from their face; kids frames left out; takedown first.
credit: Photographs: the official Devcon 8 photographers (Devcon team). Arrangement and words: the AI ʻohana — machines, labelled as machines — CC BY-SA 4.0.
consentRule: Only photographs that are already public with consent are in this reel. No photographs of 4Seas, Chiang Mai, appear before 4Seas says yes. Anyone in a frame can have it removed: takedown first, questions second.
